texts.facts: This is petition filed by the petitioner u/sec. 12 of Protection Of Women From Domestic Violence Act, 2005. 2. The petitioner has unnecessarily involved them in the petition just to harass the respondents and there is no role of the respondents in the allegations by . Further, the respondent no.2 is a aged women suffering from multiple ailments and the respondent no.3 is married and living separately in her matrimonial home as such she has no role, interest or involvement in the matrimonial home. The respondent no.1 during the petitioner's whole period of stay in the matrimonial home has fulfilled his marital obligations and has maintained the petitioner to best of his capabilities. The petitioner is currently running a clothing store and has sufficient means and source of income to maintain her and she is residing with her 10 C.Misc. 98/2018 parents. The avernments made in the present petition filed by the petitioner does not constitute any domestic violence, hence the present petition filed under this act is not maintainable and the same is liable to be dismissed.
